audit.whatIsWrong: The page attributes Quinn's blind to Vault (E) in roughly a dozen strings — 'Vault (Dash/Blind)', 'her E Vault blinds', 'E vault-blind', 'E blind', 'Blind + disengage in one button'. Vault does not blind.
audit.why: Riot's text: Vault (E, 675 range, 12/11/10/9/8s) dashes to the target, damages, slows, briefly interrupts, and lands Quinn back near her max attack range. The vision hinder is Blinding Assault (Q, 1025 range, 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s). A Lillia told the blind rides on the dash will step up while the Q — the longer-range, more punishing button — is still available, and will wait out the wrong cooldown before committing.
audit.corrected: Blind reassigned to Blinding Assault throughout; Vault restated as the dash that knocks her out of her Q chain and slows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1, Levels 4-5 and Level 6 were marked Skill while the content whys say Lillia concedes the opening 'hard', that her best window 'still loses here', and that Level 6 is 'your one spike'.
audit.why: Quinn's spikes are levels 1-3 (range plus Harrier procs) and her own first item; Lillia's only genuine window is Lilting Lullaby at 6, and only if she baits Vault first so the sleep is not interrupted.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4 set to Quinn, Quinn, Lillia with ratings 3, 3, 6 as matched full+content pairs.

audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 is right and possibly generous: 33.33% win rate, and Lillia's 450-range Q cannot reach a champion whose poke starts at 1025 and whose E resets the spacing on an 8s cooldown late.

edits.before: Quinn out-ranges everything you do at level 1-3. Every time you hop in for a Q sweetspot to start your Dream Dust burn, she answers with an E Vault that knocks you back and blinds your follow-up, then her Harrier-empowered auto chips you on the way out. Do not chase her with Q to stack movement speed — she just kites with her own passive nimbleness and you take free poke. Farm with the outer edge of Q from max range, accept you are behind, and never walk into Vault range with your E down.
edits.after: Quinn out-ranges everything you do at level 1-3. Every time you hop in for a Q sweetspot to start your Dream Dust burn, she answers with an E Vault that knocks you back and a Blinding Assault that kills your follow-up, then her Harrier-empowered auto chips you on the way out. Do not chase her with Q to stack movement speed — she just kites on the speed her W gives her after a Harrier auto. Farm with the outer edge of Q from max range, accept you are behind, and never walk into Vault range with your E down.

edits.before: This stays bad. Even once Liandry's/Riftmaker makes your W and DoT deal real percent-HP damage, Quinn hits her own item timing and her Harrier kiting plus E blind means she chips you down before your hops connect. She also out-roams you off her passive move speed, so she snowballs the map while you struggle to find a clean engage. Your only path is to convert any Level 6 sleep pick into objectives with your team and roam to lanes where the enemy can't kite you — do not keep forcing the side lane 1v1 into her.
edits.after: This stays bad. notes: Systematic error fixed: the blind was attributed to Vault (E) everywhere. Blinding Assault (Q) is the blind; Vault is the dash/knock-off/slow. The full layer's focus.text, loading, winCon, enemyWin and tradeBad still carry the literal label 'Vault (Dash/Blind)' — those are template-generated from the same wrong focus string, so they are better fixed by regenerating the focus than by patching each copy, and I left them for that sweep. Also corrected: Quinn's roaming speed comes from Behind Enemy Lines and the post-Harrier speed from Heightened Senses (W), not from her passive.
